title: Kit demo — twelve kilometers of trail

voiceover.voice: Not recorded — this demo ships with estimated timings.
voiceover.notes: Replace public/audio/voiceover.wav, run scripts/prepare-audio.mjs, then regenerate captions.

music.notes: Drop any licensed/CC track here. It fades in over 0.5 s and out over 1.2 s.

narration: Twelve kilometers of trail, one tiny world. Every tile holds a whole story inside it. Drop through the crust and the world flips. Same kit, every single time.
